what_changed: Original single arrival of 200 boilers on day 7 is being split/delayed: Option A ships 80 on day 7 and 120 on day 21; Option B ships all 200 on day 13.

options.name: Option A (80 on day 7, 120 on day 21)

decisions_for_a_person: Choose between Option A (puts order O-2205, 5 units short, 4 days late, late_penalty applies) and Option B (puts order O-2203, 40 units short, 1 day late, late_penalty applies) within the supplier's 3-business-day deadline.
If no decision is made by the deadline, the supplier will default to Option B, which puts O-2203 at risk instead of O-2205 — confirm whether this default is acceptable.
supplier_questions: Which shipping option (A or B) would Copperline like to choose, within three business days?
